# open-gateway-api-framework-overview.png

**Type:** Conceptual overview illustration.
**Source context:** `# Introduction`, right after the paragraph introducing Open Gateway as an industry initiative to create a standardized framework for APIs.

**What it shows:** two stacked panels joined by two arrows.

- **Top panel:** icons for consuming applications and industries (smart glasses, AI/robotics, cloud, bus, truck, video, VR headset, car).
- **Middle:** an upward arrow labelled **Open Service (Northbound) Common Network API**, which exposes network capabilities to the top panel, and a horizontal double-headed arrow labelled **Open Federation APIs (East West Federation & Interconnection)**.
- **Bottom panel:** the logos of the three bodies behind the framework — **CAMARA** (The Telco Global API Alliance), **GSMA** and **TM Forum** — above icons for network capabilities (location/globe, radio mast, cloud, analytics, SIM, 5G, database, monitoring, document/security, fingerprint/identity).
